ScrollPanel.summary: Scrollable container control: shows scrollbars when the content exceeds the client area and supports smooth scrolling. Inherits from Control.

props.classname: Control class name, fixed to "scrollpanel"; skins match styles by it
props.padding: Content padding {left, top, right, bottom} in pixels; scrollbarSize is added on the right/bottom when scrollbars are shown
props.scrollPosX: Horizontal scroll offset in pixels (0 = far left); maintained by SetScrollPos, the mouse wheel and scrollbar dragging
props.scrollPosY: Vertical scroll offset in pixels (0 = top); clamped to the content height
props.verticalScrollbar: Whether a vertical scrollbar may be shown; default true. Actual visibility depends on the content height
props.horizontalScrollbar: Whether a horizontal scrollbar may be shown; default true. Actual visibility depends on the content width
props.verticalSmartScroll: When true, stays pinned to the bottom if the panel was scrolled to the bottom before a layout change; default false
props.smoothScroll: Whether SetScrollPos animates with smooth scrolling; default true
props.smoothScrollTime: Smooth-scroll animation duration in seconds; default 0.7
props.ignoreMouseWheel: When true the mouse wheel does not scroll this panel but is passed to the parent; default false

ScrollPanel:SetScrollPos.desc: Sets the scroll offset in pixels, optionally centering content in the viewport and optionally skipping the smooth animation; calls Invalidate.

params.x: Horizontal scroll position in pixels; nil leaves it unchanged
params.y: Vertical scroll position in pixels; nil leaves it unchanged
params.inview: When true, x/y are content coordinates to center in the viewport
params.forceNotSmooth: When true, jumps directly without animating

ScrollPanel:Update.desc: Advances the smooth-scroll interpolation (cubic smoothstep), clears the animation when done and calls the parent Update.

Arguments forwarded to the parent Update

ScrollPanel:LocalToClient.desc: Local to client content coordinates: subtracts the clientArea origin and adds the scroll offset.

ScrollPanel:ClientToLocal.desc: Client content coordinates to local coordinates: adds the clientArea origin and subtracts the scroll offset.

ScrollPanel:ParentToClient.desc: Parent to client content coordinates, additionally subtracting this control's x/y.

ScrollPanel:ClientToParent.desc: Client content coordinates to parent coordinates, additionally adding this control's x/y.

ScrollPanel:GetCurrentExtents.desc: Returns the extents spanning this control and its children; the current implementation uses undefined globals, so it looks like dead legacy code.

ScrollPanel:_DetermineContentArea.desc: Computes contentArea from the children extents, adds or removes the scrollbar padding as needed and refreshes clientArea. (internal)

ScrollPanel:UpdateLayout.desc: Realigns children and updates the content area, realigns again when scrollbar visibility changed, then clamps the scroll offsets.

ScrollPanel:IsRectInView.desc: Tests whether a rectangle lies inside the visible area, then asks the parent recursively; returns false without a parent.

ScrollPanel:DrawControl.desc: Empty implementation; the actual background/scrollbar drawing is overridden by skins/themes.

ScrollPanel:_DrawInClientArea.desc: Draws inside the client area: optionally clips with a scissor, translates by the scroll offset and calls fnc(...). (internal)

ScrollPanel:IsAboveHScrollbars.desc: Whether the coordinates fall on the horizontal scrollbar strip (requires _hscrollbar to be enabled).

ScrollPanel:IsAboveVScrollbars.desc: Whether the coordinates fall on the vertical scrollbar strip (requires _vscrollbar to be enabled).

ScrollPanel:HitTest.desc: Hit test: returns self over a scrollbar strip, otherwise delegates to the parent HitTest.

ScrollPanel:MouseDown.desc: When pressed on a scrollbar, jumps to that scroll position and enters dragging; otherwise delegates to the parent.

ScrollPanel:MouseMove.desc: While dragging, updates the scroll offset; otherwise refreshes the scrollbar hover highlight and invalidates when it changes.

ScrollPanel:MouseUp.desc: Ends scrollbar dragging and applies the final scroll position; otherwise delegates to the parent.

ScrollPanel:MouseWheel.desc: With a vertical scrollbar, scrolls the content by value*30 and clamps; otherwise passes the wheel event to the parent.

params.value: Wheel value, which determines the scroll amount

ScrollPanel:MouseOut.desc: Clears the hover state of the horizontal/vertical scrollbars and invalidates.

fileDesc: Scrollable container control: computes the content area from the children extents, shows horizontal/vertical scrollbars as needed and provides smooth scrolling plus scrollbar dragging.
